candidates.description: This vector represents common Portuguese grammatical particles, articles, pronouns, and auxiliary verbs.
This vector represents the broader concepts of visual media, entertainment, and the film industry across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents possessive pronouns and determiners across multiple languages.
This vector represents Spanish and Portuguese adverbial suffixes and related morphosyntactic word endings.
This vector activates on words, roots, and subword tokens containing the contiguous letter sequence "str" or "esc".
This feature vector represents words and subwords starting with the letters "s" or "su".
This vector activates strongly for words and roots related to perception, discernment, and cognitive evaluation.
This feature vector represents terms associated with film and home video media releases.
This vector activates on tokens related to vision, sight, and visual or audio-visual media.
This vector represents concepts related to consequences, sequences, and ensuing events across multiple languages.
